text.EN: I can't wait there right now.
That spot is in the line of fire. I won't wait there.
text.TL: Nasa linya ng putukan ang pwestong 'yon. Di ako maghihintay doon.

text.EN: Standing out in the open like that is suicide.
text.TL: Pagpapakamatay ang tumayo sa bukas na lugar nang ganoon.

text.EN: Refusing to wait in an unsecured position.
text.TL: Tumatangging maghintay sa di-ligtas na posisyon.

text.EN: Too many hostiles nearby to just stand around.
text.TL: Masyadong maraming kalaban sa paligid para tumayo-tayo lang.

text.EN: I need to stay on the move. Can't wait there.
text.TL: Kailangan kong gumalaw. Di makapaghihintay doon.

text.EN: Wait order rejected. Find a safer spot.
text.TL: Tinatanggihan ang paghihintay. Maghanap ng mas ligtas na lugar.

text.EN: I won't wait in a compromised sector.
text.TL: Di ako maghihintay sa delikadong lugar.

text.EN: Unable to comply. That location has zero cover.
text.TL: Di makasusunod. Walang silong ang lugar na 'yan.

text.EN: I can't wait at that position.
